Priya (SRE Lead): Filing Aperture postmortem follow-ups — focus: VPC peering flaps, on-prem routing constraints, and an isolation bug that caused tenant bleed. I'll track owners and timelines here.

Marco (NetEng): I'll take the VPC peering flaps. Plan: capture tcpdump from transit nodes, check BGP timers, and correlate with autoscale activity. ETA Fri 2026-03-27.

Aisha (Onprem TPM): I'll own the on-prem constraints doc + mitigation checklist (serial console access, PSK rotation, vendor contact). Uploading runbook shortly.

Ben (Infra Eng): Isolation bug (tenant cookie/session collision) — filed RH-5432, I'll triage and work a hotfix. Expect a patch candidate this week.

SRE-Bot: Incident created: RH-5432 assigned to Ben, priority P2.

Priya (SRE Lead): Thanks — please include verification steps & a small prod smoke test for each fix (low-traffic canary). Also add the Jira IDs here when available.

Marco (NetEng): For the peering change we need a customer maintenance window. @Sam (Customer Success) can you confirm availability 2026-03-28 02:00-03:00 UTC?

Sam (Customer Success): Confirmed — Aperture agreed to 03/28 02:00-04:00 UTC (they want a 2-hour buffer).

Aisha (Onprem TPM): Draft mitigation checklist uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/aperture-mitigation-v1 (includes pre-checks, recovery steps, and escalation contacts).

Ben (Infra Eng): Quick root cause note: NAT conntrack state expired unexpectedly when peer flapped; kernel conntrack timeouts + iptables ordering implicated. Working on kernel tunables + unit tests.

Priya (SRE Lead): Ownership summary (please confirm):
- Marco: VPC peering investigation + config hardening — due 2026-03-27 (Jira: RH-5480)
- Ben: Isolation bug fix + canary + patch release — due 2026-03-30 (Jira: RH-5432 -> RH-5500)
- Aisha: On-prem constraints doc + runbook PR — due 2026-03-26 (Jira: RH-5481)
- Priya: Coordination, postmortem writeup + follow-ups — due 2026-03-31

Marco (NetEng): Created RH-5480 for peering config and hardening tasks.

Aisha (Onprem TPM): RH-5481 runbook PR opened, please review the checklist & vendor contact section.

Ben (Infra Eng): RH-5432 fix branch -> will push to RH-5500 release pipeline. I'll post canary URL once CI passes.

Priya (SRE Lead): Recurring pattern note — we observed similar peering flaps in two other Dedicated customers last quarter (different transit providers). I'll open an SLO/regression ticket to add monitoring for peer jitter and BGP flap rate and propose a small fast-path rollback plan.

Sam (Customer Success): FYI CS will send pre-works and the peering change template to Aperture today.

Marco (NetEng): :thumbsup:

Ben (Infra Eng): :eyes:

Priya (SRE Lead): Quick sync scheduled tomorrow 11:00 PST to confirm blockers and PR status. If anything blocks before then, drop notes here (saves meeting time).

SRE-Bot: Reminder scheduled: 3067894200 (tomorrow 11:00 PST) — reminder ping.
